Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2025 • GDPR Compliant

1. Client-Side Processing (Zero Data Collection)

Your privacy is our core priority. All calculation amounts, rates, and formulas entered into Calculadora IVA are computed entirely within your web browser using client-side JavaScript. We do not store, log, transmit, or sell your financial figures to any external servers.

2. Local Storage

We use browser localStorage solely to remember your chosen visual theme (Light Mode vs. Dark Mode) across sessions. No personal identifiable information (PII) is stored.

3. Contact Inquiries

If you submit a message via our Contact form, your name and email address are used exclusively to respond to your inquiry and are never shared with third parties.

4. Your Rights Under GDPR

Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, or erase any personal information you have provided to us. For inquiries, contact contacto@calculadoraiva.es.
